steps.npc: I was minding my own business in that abandoned shack for the night and suddenly I could hear...
No... Don't interrupt!
Where was I?
That was it... a faint sound... wind chimes...

steps.player: Please don't tell me you were attacked by the wind.

steps.npc: What did I say about interruptions?

The chiming grew louder and started to sound like the knocking of bones. I was in the bed hiding under the moth-eaten sheet - ignorance is bliss, y'know? - and suddenly the sheet was pulled off of me and there was
a-
I SAID NO INTER- Oh yes, that's correct... Skeletons. Two of the blighters.

steps.player: Well, you seem to have got away in one piece!

steps.npc: One piece?! Do you not-
THE BONEY BLIGHTER BIT MY FOOT!

steps.player: Sorry... You didn't leave anything behind did you? I'm a brave adventurer! I'm sure I can pry whatever it is from their malicious mitts.

steps.npc: A few pots, but without my tools they won'y do me any good.
Me? Just a tinker with nothing to trade.
A tinker doesn't get the respect that they used to... Gah! A thief took my bag in the night, they took everything.

steps.player: Sorry to hear you've had some bad luck of late, did you lose much?

steps.npc: Bits and pieces, nothing too important I s'pose... An old pan flute, a dirty book and a charred skull.
That's all in the past now, anyway... I'm afraid I can't help you.

steps.player: That's alright, I need no help.

steps.npc: Didn't someone send you for the pots?
Well, if anyone asks... I'm dead!

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Are you the tinker this entry mentions?

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: Oh, me? Oh my... Goodness gracious what...
Well, I s'pose that was me...
How did you find me!? Was it you?

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Was it me what? I just found this journal... I didn't write it.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: I remember this day... How could I forget.
Are you saying the man I sold those trinkets to was the king?!
Those were dark objects, corrupted with powerful magic. Dark magic.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Well, it's all in the past now. I don't think there's any reason to worry about it.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: No, no, no... this ain't good. They'll find me.
You already know too much. But you don't know my name. Good. Let's keep it that way.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Well if I find out anything useful, I'll come let you know, alright?

using-items-on-him-any-item-worth-one-mi.player: No, I didn't mean for you to keep it.

using-items-on-him-any-item-worth-one-mi.npc: Then why are you handing it to me?

steps.npc: Who?
It's alright mate! We've all been there.
It'll pass! Anyhow, I'll be seeing you.

using-items-on-him-any-other-item.npc: I'm afraid I've nothing to trade for that.
